name: Verisk Underwriting Intelligence
description: Verisk Underwriting Intelligence provides conversational access to trusted ISO Loss Cost insights within Claude, designed for underwriters, actuaries, and product teams with an ISO Core Lines Services subscription. Today, users can explore loss cost indications, experience trends, and filing-aligned intelligence without navigating specialized tools or reports. All outputs are grounded in Verisk's authoritative ISO data and established actuarial methodologies, supporting confident, regulator-ready decisions. Built as an extensible connector, Verisk Underwriting Intelligence is designed to expand over time as additional underwriting insights and capabilities become available.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Verisk Underwriting Intelligence to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Verisk Underwriting Intelligence to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://gatewaymcp.verisk.com/underwriting/intelligencemcp/v1. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Verisk Underwriting Intelligence MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Verisk Underwriting Intelligence provides these MCP tools: iso_losscost_activity_get, iso_losscost_experienceindex_get, iso_losscost_indications_get, and iso_visualizer_skill_include.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Verisk Underwriting Intelligence?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Verisk Underwriting Intelligence in financial-services on the Manufact MCP catalog include Contract-Factory — Sociétés & SIREN, Kavara Kirk, CeylonCharts, Netzo, and Ramp Data.

_published_faq.name: Does Verisk Underwriting Intelligence MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Verisk Underwriting Intelligence requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Verisk Underwriting Intelligence is developed by Verisk Analytics. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
